description: This file is the entry point for the React frontend application. It imports React libraries, global CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for the specified DOM element, enabling React 18's concurrent features.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node.
